topic: Day 58 — reel — Growth means being willing to feel like a beginner again, repeatedly
text:
Growth keeps
making you a
[beginner] again.
caption:
Competence in one place makes incompetence in another feel unbearable. Every new domain charges the same entry fee, no matter what you've already mastered.
